verdict.rationale: Clerk documents API keys for programmatic callers and M2M tokens that authenticate calls between agents, as a metered machine-authentication feature. This gives agents their own credentials instead of a human's. It also documents gating individual tool calls against the caller's Clerk permissions and scopes, plus custom OAuth scopes for MCP clients. However, the evidence never shows how M2M tokens or API keys are narrowly scoped per agent, and revocation is documented only for human user sessions. Missing for 10: documented instant revocation of machine tokens/API keys, explicit per-machine-identity least-privilege scoping docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
